workload_profile: Primary production workload is multi-tenant chat support routed by region, plus batched nightly reranking for call transcripts. Live traffic profile: steady-state 120 QPS aggregate across NA region, daily peak up to 420 QPS during promos (3.5x peak factor). Average request payload (prompt + context) ~350 tokens; average generated response ~320 tokens. Expected concurrency distribution: 70% short chats (<128 tokens), 30% long responses (~300-500 tokens).
throughput_requirements: Aggregate tokens/sec at steady-state: ~80k tokens/sec (120 QPS * 670 tokens)
Aggregate tokens/sec at peak: ~281k tokens/sec (420 QPS * 670 tokens)
latency_slo_targets: Short-response SLO (<=128 tokens): p50 < 120 ms, p95 < 350 ms
Long-response SLO (~300 tokens): p50 < 520 ms, p95 < 1.2 s
End-to-end (including network and routing): target p95 < 1.5 s for typical chat flows
Availability SLO: 99.9% with financial SLA for enterprise tier requested
sizing_recommendation: Recommended prod reserved footprint: 6 x H100-80GB equivalent GPUs in NA region for steady-state (handles baseline with autoscaling buffer)
Peak buffer & burst: add reserved burst pool or autoscale to additional 8 GPUs on demand to cover 3.5x peak; propose hybrid reserved+burst model
Model choice: primary inference on llama-3-13b-q4 or equivalent Redwood-verified 13B quantized build; fallback to 7B variant for degraded modes and overflow traffic
Cache & batching: enable prefix KV caching for repeated session prompts and dynamic batching at 50-200ms window to maximize throughput without breaching latency SLOs
Estimated steady cost uplift: reserved baseline covers 80% of tokens; burst usage billed at overage rates — renders a more predictable ARR with 6 reserved GPUs + 8 burst
poC_plan: 4-week POC: week 1 deploy private VPC control plane + networking tests, week 2 ingest sample transcripts and run latency QPS ramp, week 3 validate failover/routing and fallback models, week 4 run 72h soak at 1.2x steady and two 1hr peak spikes at 3.5x. Acceptance criteria: meet latency SLOs for 95th percentile in steady state, validate autoscaling triggers, demonstrate prefix cache hit rate > 30% on chat sessions.
